name: Evaluated On Ref
description: The ref a rule suite evaluated a push against. Resolved to a git_ref node when that ref was collected; a suite naming a ref that has since been deleted simply carries no edge, and its `ref` field remains the record. (Ref target: the neutral git_core__git_ref since github-core#76.)

before_sha.description: Ref tip before the push. All zeroes for a branch creation.
